title: Allow to control autoHideContainer behavior
body:
The default behavior of autoHideContainer is widget based.

Given the widget, we will apply some rules that ultimately will decide if we want to show or hide the widget.

Some of those rules, may or may not make sense given the user use case. See #986.

I believe we should allow the user to override that default behavior.

comments.body: I would like to see this as an optional feature
This can be done with instantsearch.js v2's connectors.
